review_comment: The from_yaml method directly calls yaml.load() on untrusted input, creating a deserialization vulnerability. The function lacks any input validation or sanitization controls. Replace yaml.load(content) with yaml.safe_load(content) to prevent arbitrary code execution through malicious YAML constructs.

The from_json method directly deserializes untrusted JSON data without validation, creating a CWE-502 vulnerability. The 'content' parameter originates from HTTP requests and flows directly to simplejson.loads(). Add input validation or sanitization before deserialization to prevent arbitrary code execution.
